    <bpmn:task id="Task_Submit" name="Submit application online"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_DocsMerge" name="Documents check merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Review" name="Review application and supporting documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_DocsCheck" name="All documents received?" default="Flow_DocsMissing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyMissing" name="Notify applicant of missing items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideMissing" name="Provide missing items"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_ForkEval" name="Start evaluation and fee processing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Evaluate" name="Evaluate application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Fees" name="Process application fees or waivers"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_JoinEval" name="Evaluation and fees complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Accepted" name="Application accepted?" default="Flow_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AcceptLetter" name="Send acceptance letter"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RejectLetter" name="Send rejection letter"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rejected" name="Application rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmEnroll" name="Confirm enrollment by deadline"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CancelApp" name="Cancel application"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Canceled" name="Application canceled"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_ConfFork" name="Start orientation and account setup"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Orientation" name="Send orientation materials"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Accounts" name="Set up email, online portal and library accounts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_ConfJoin" name="Orientation and accounts complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Intl" name="International student?" default="Flow_IntlNo"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Visa" name="Assist with visa processing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_IntlMerge" name="Visa step merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainID" name="Obtain student ID card"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Advisor" name="Meet with academic advisor"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCourses" name="Select courses"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Conflicts" name="Resolve schedule conflicts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Attend" name="Attend classes"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_AddDropCheck" name="Add or drop courses?" default="Flow_AddDropNo"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddDrop" name="Add or drop courses within add/drop period"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_AddDropMerge" name="Add/drop merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostGrades" name="Post grades at end of semester"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewGrades" name="Review grades online"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Grievance" name="Grievance filed?" default="Flow_NoGrievance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppealForm" name="Submit appeal form"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppealMeet" name="Meet with appeals committee"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwaitDecision" name="Await appeal decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_AppealMerge" name="Grievance outcome merge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Continue" name="Graduates, withdraws or continues to next semester?" default="Flow_NextSemester"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordGraduation" name="Record student graduation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordWithdrawal" name="Record student withdrawal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Graduates" name="Student graduates"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Withdraws" name="Student withdraws"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="Start_Apply" targetRef="Task_Submit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submitted" sourceRef="Task_Submit" targetRef="Gw_DocsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToReview" sourceRef="Gw_DocsMerge" targetRef="Task_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reviewed" sourceRef="Task_Review" targetRef="Gw_DocsCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocsComplete" sourceRef="Gw_DocsCheck" targetRef="Gw_ForkEval">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${documentsComplete}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocsMissing" name="Documents missing" sourceRef="Gw_DocsCheck" targetRef="Task_NotifyMissing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notified" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMissing" targetRef="Task_ProvideMissing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Provided" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMissing" targetRef="Gw_DocsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEvaluate" sourceRef="Gw_ForkEval" targetRef="Task_Evaluate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToFees" sourceRef="Gw_ForkEval" targetRef="Task_Fees"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evaluated" sourceRef="Task_Evaluate" targetRef="Gw_JoinEval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeesDone" sourceRef="Task_Fees" targetRef="Gw_JoinEval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision" sourceRef="Gw_JoinEval" targetRef="Gw_Accepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accepted" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gw_Accepted" targetRef="Task_AcceptLetter">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${applicationAccepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gw_Accepted" targetRef="Task_RejectLetter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectSent" sourceRef="Task_RejectLetter" targetRef="End_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptSent" sourceRef="Task_AcceptLetter" targetRef="Task_ConfirmEnroll"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmEnroll" targetRef="Gw_ConfirmCheck"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${enrollmentConfirmed}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotConfirmed" name="Not confirmed" sourceRef="Gw_ConfirmCheck" targetRef="Task_CancelApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Canceled" sourceRef="Task_CancelApp" targetRef="End_Canceled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToOrientation" sourceRef="Gw_ConfFork" targetRef="Task_Orientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToAccounts" sourceRef="Gw_ConfFork" targetRef="Task_Accounts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrientationSent" sourceRef="Task_Orientation" targetRef="Gw_ConfJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountsDone" sourceRef="Task_Accounts" targetRef="Gw_ConfJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetupDone" sourceRef="Gw_ConfJoin" targetRef="Gw_Intl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IntlYes" name="International" sourceRef="Gw_Intl" targetRef="Task_Visa">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${internationalStudent}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IntlNo" name="Not international" sourceRef="Gw_Intl" targetRef="Gw_IntlMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaDone" sourceRef="Task_Visa" targetRef="Gw_IntlMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToID" sourceRef="Gw_IntlMerge" targetRef="Task_ObtainID"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IDObtained" sourceRef="Task_ObtainID" targetRef="Task_Advisor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdvisorMet" sourceRef="Task_Advisor" targetRef="Task_SelectCourses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CoursesSelected" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourses" targetRef="Task_Conflicts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConflictsResolved" sourceRef="Task_Conflicts" targetRef="Task_Attend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Attending" sourceRef="Task_Attend" targetRef="Gw_AddDropCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddDropYes" name="Add or drop" sourceRef="Gw_AddDropCheck" targetRef="Task_AddDrop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${addDropRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddDropNo" name="No change" sourceRef="Gw_AddDropCheck" targetRef="Gw_AddDropMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddDropDone" sourceRef="Task_AddDrop" targetRef="Gw_AddDropMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SemesterEnd" sourceRef="Gw_AddDropMerge" targetRef="Task_PostGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GradesPosted" sourceRef="Task_PostGrades" targetRef="Task_ReviewGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GradesReviewed" sourceRef="Task_ReviewGrades" targetRef="Gw_Grievance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GrievanceYes" name="Grievance" sourceRef="Gw_Grievance" targetRef="Task_AppealForm">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${grievanceFiled}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoGrievance" name="No grievance" sourceRef="Gw_Grievance" targetRef="Gw_AppealMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppealFiled" sourceRef="Task_AppealForm" targetRef="Task_AppealMeet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppealMet" sourceRef="Task_AppealMeet" targetRef="Task_AwaitDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppealDecided" sourceRef="Task_AwaitDecision" targetRef="Gw_AppealMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AfterAppeal" sourceRef="Gw_AppealMerge" targetRef="Gw_Continue"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextSemester" name="Continues to next semester" sourceRef="Gw_Continue" targetRef="Task_SelectCourses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Graduates" name="Graduates" sourceRef="Gw_Continue" targetRef="Task_RecordGraduation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${studentGraduates}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdraws" name="Withdraws" sourceRef="Gw_Continue" targetRef="Task_RecordWithdrawal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${studentWithdraws}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GraduationRecorded" sourceRef="Task_RecordGraduation" targetRef="End_Graduates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WithdrawalRecorded" sourceRef="Task_RecordWithdrawal" targetRef="End_Withdraws"/>
  </bpmn:process>
